name: Smart Search's page as viewer in the Auto host mode (PageHostMode=Auto at startup, with Plugin Pages installed): GET /PluginPages/User lists Jellyfin.Plugin.SmartSearch.SearchPage with its shell URL and the title 'Advanced Search', the kit chose the Plugin Pages host, the link sits in Plugin Pages' drawer section and not in 'Library tools', the page renders in that host under its title, and a hard reload of its link renders it again. Needs a sandbox started in Auto mode (Set-SandboxPluginConfig PageHostMode=Auto, then a restart).

steps.name: open the login page
index.html carries Plugin Pages' tag (its startup task registers the File Transformation a few seconds after the server starts)
steps.waitFor: fetch(new URL('index.html', location.href), { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.text()).then(t => /<script plugin="PluginPages"/.test(t))

steps.name: reload, so the page has the tag
sign in as viewer
the Smart Search script ran
index.html: the head fragment in Auto mode, the page on
steps.eval: fetch(new URL('index.html', location.href), { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.text()).then(t => { const s = t.match(/<script type="application\/json" data-jfss-head data-jfss-pages>([^<]*)<\/script>/); return { state: s ? JSON.parse(s[1]) : null, pluginPagesTag: /<script plugin="PluginPages"/.test(t) }; })

steps.name: Auto, search known and on, Plugin Pages' tag there
GET /PluginPages/User
lists the page's Id, shell URL and title (registered at startup through Plugin Pages' DI manager)
the kit chose the Plugin Pages host
its link
open the drawer
the link in Plugin Pages' section
steps.waitFor: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .pluginMenuOptions a[data-itemid="Jellyfin.Plugin.SmartSearch.SearchPage"]'); if (!a) return false; const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; })()

steps.name: no 'Library tools' link of ours for it while Plugin Pages shows it
click it
the page renders in Plugin Pages' host under its title
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.userPreferencesPage:not(.hide) [data-jfss-page="search"][data-jfss-mounted][data-jfss-state="on"]')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); if (!r) return false; const body = r.querySelector('.jfss-search'); if (!body) return false; return { host: r.getAttribute('data-jfss-host'), title: (document.querySelector('.skinHeader .pageTitle') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.trim(), hash: location.hash, text: body.textContent.trim() }; })()

steps.name: as expected (Plugin Pages' own link leaves pageUrl unencoded; ours encode it)
open our own link to it
hard reload
after the reload: the page in Plugin Pages' host
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.userPreferencesPage:not(.hide) [data-jfss-page="search"][data-jfss-mounted][data-jfss-state="on"]')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); const body = r && r.querySelector('.jfss-search'); return !!body && r.getAttribute('data-jfss-host') === 'PluginPages' && /Title contains/.test(body.textContent); })()

steps.name: the fallback address still works in Auto mode
it hands over to the Plugin Pages host or renders on its fallback host
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-jfss-page="search"][data-jfss-mounted]')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); const body = r && r.querySelector('.jfss-search'); return body && /Title contains/.test(body.textContent) ? { host: r.getAttribute('data-jfss-host'), hash: location.hash } : false; })()

steps.name: no uncaught exception (the stale CustomRatings tag of the sandbox's index.html is known noise)
